summary: The seedling subsidy evaluation was classified as Low Effectiveness based on the combined evaluation records of 30 respondents. The model produced an overall confidence of 49.71% for the low effectiveness classification. Respondents recorded an average questionnaire score of 3.12 and an average yield per hectare of 5.60 tons/ha. Of the 30 evaluation records, 2 were classified as moderate, 13 as high, and 15 as low effectiveness.
